faq_intro: The final website can show the company’s own terms and answers.
faq1q: Can I book just one cleaning?
faq1a: Yes, both one-off and regular cleaning can be quoted separately.
faq2q: Can upholstery cleaning be booked separately?
faq2a: Yes, sofas, armchairs, mattresses and other textile surfaces can be quoted separately.
faq3q: Can the price be given in advance?
faq3a: The final price depends on area, tasks and condition.
faq4q: Can apartment changeover cleaning be included?
faq4a: Yes, the service can be configured for recurring holiday-apartment changeovers.
